sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: The NSW Police Force (NSWPF) seeks to obtain quotes from reliable and suitably qualified supplier capable of providing commercial car parking rate information and annual reporting services for Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) purposes.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The supplier will:
- Provide accurate commercial car parking rate data.
- Support FBT calculations and compliance with Australian Taxation Office (ATO) requirements.
- Deliver annual parking rate reports within required timeframes
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
1.
Ability to Fulfil All Requirements of the Statement of Work
Please confirm that you have the capacity, capability, and resources to perform all requirements outlined in the Statement of Work and deliver the services to a high standard.
Response type
Checkbox (Agree)
2.
Compliance with RFQ Requirements and Contract Terms
Respondents must demonstrate full compliance with all requirements outlined in this Request for Quotation (RFQ), including all associated rules, guidelines, conditions, and instructions.
Respondents must also demonstrate compliance with the proposed contract terms. Any departures, qualifications, exclusions, or proposed amendments must be clearly identified and fully documented within the response. Failure to disclose departures may result in the response being assessed on the basis that full compliance has been offered.
Response type
Checkbox (Agree)
3.
Demonstrated Experience Delivering Similar Services
Respondents must demonstrate experience providing similar services to one or more large Australian organisations for a minimum of two years.
Response type
Checkbox (Agree)
4.
Upload Response Documents
Please upload your response documents here.
Your response should address the selection criteria and, at a minimum, include the information requested in Section 7 of the RFQ. Additional supporting information may also be provided where relevant.
Response type
File upload (Multiple)
